rationale: The Latin anchors *bellum*, *pugna*, and *certamen* all point to literal armed conflict, and the attestations from Beowulf, Judith, and the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle confirm a concrete martial sense of physical fighting/warfare. War.n.01 ("the waging of armed conflict against an enemy") best captures this, as opposed to the legal declaration sense (n.02) or the metaphorical campaign sense (n.03–04).
